conditions.config_input: Owned app.json explicitly authored false after preconditioning stop, verified on restart before every required false branch. Runtime setConfig debounce is not used as proof of persisted input.
conditions.scope: Four required actual CLI move branches plus one pending-source-edit control. The genuine native dialog button handlers are delivered programmatically by an owned probe; UI hit testing/visual parity is not claimed. No fabricated decision outcome, imported cache or bytes.
conditions.decision_transport: Owned outside-vault decision file read by finite probe timer; native CLI Popen output/pending sampled independently. Handles decisions even if another CLI request cannot run while pending.
conditions.preconditioning: Real initial helper note then actual Vault.create initial_files and delete ParityReady; real clean/commit before same-profile restart with probe plugin.
conditions.command_boundary: Native FileManager original promise resolution frame is captured before CLI handler response; actual CLI output receipt separate. Metadata clean/stat/hash + readonly IDB transaction.done separate.
conditions.portable_history: Observation event/marker copies are scoped to their operation using recorded starting cursors; every in-row event and full selected state remains unchanged. Complete raw history is retained separately.
